attribution: Source: Ministry of Justice, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, open data: real estate deals reports (تقارير الصفقات العقارية, moj.gov.sa). Quarterly medians of price per m² are the report's own aggregates; thresholds and rebasing are ours.
basis: MOJ register of sale deeds: quarterly median price per m² of residential deeds (all property types together; land plots dominate), by city and neighbourhood; a median of raw deeds, not a quality-adjusted index
name: Hafar Al Batin
notes: Hafar Al Batin: the city series is the median price per m² of all residential sale deeds registered with the Ministry of Justice in the city in each quarter (land plots, villas and flats together: the register's property-type field is empty), from 2023 Q1 to 2026Q3; 10 neighbourhoods have at least 15 deeds in each of 8 or more consecutive quarters. Medians of raw deeds move with the mix of plots and buildings and of inner and outer neighbourhoods; they are not a quality-adjusted index. The history starts in 2023, so the city cannot be valued yet.
unit_label: Median price per m² (SAR, residential deeds)

volume.basis: residential sale deeds registered with the Ministry of Justice, Hafar Al Batin
